versions.changelog:
- 更新 API 源地址和官网，由 cdndns.org 切换为 xungufa.com
- 配置和认证说明、Token 获取途径相应更改为 xungufa.com
- 数据接口请求路径、示例、文案等同步切换为新域名
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件，无其他核心功能变更

Initial release of 循古黄历 skill for Chinese lunar calendar and almanac information.

- Provides queries on 24 solar terms, lunar calendar dates, auspicious/taboo activities, fortune, and yellow calendar details.
- Integrates with 循古排盘 API (https://cdndns.org), requires configurable Bearer Token.
- Returns detailed daily calendar info: Gregorian/lunar date, three-stem Ganzhi, recommended and taboo activities, luck hour slots, Chongsha, moon phase, Taoist and Buddhist calendar.
- Supports querying specific dates as well as today's almanac.
- Designed for easy integration with OpenClaw via environment variable configuration.
